pages.title: Sorganeil — Sight Binding
pages.text: $(o)Binds a target while you watch it.$()

Wirbel's binding: paralyses one target while you keep it in sight; losing sight of it, death or logout releases it. Three levels extend the maximum hold. Deals no damage; holds the target for 4 + 2 × level seconds while you keep it in sight.
